title: Preview shows the fill screen read-only, except the axle control
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  • A template draft being edited, with a per-axle field, unsaved edits, and a reference file attached, open in Preview.
custom_steps:
1. Switch to Preview from the sub-header control and confirm it mounts the fill screen itself against the current draft (unsaved edits included), with the properties panel stepping aside, the canvas taking its width and the sections rail staying (one section at a time).
2. Confirm Preview is read-only except the axle control: adding/deleting an axle writes the count back to the draft; no values, verdicts, Mark OK, Add Note or Add Photo are accepted; a reference file still opens; and no submit bar is drawn.
3. Confirm Preview works on a draft without publishing first, and clicking a field returns to Edit with that field selected.
4. Confirm Preview explains nothing about itself — no 'nothing is saved' banner and no line stating how many axles the technician starts on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The builder offers a Preview mode alongside Edit (switched from a sub-header control) that mounts the fill screen itself against the current draft, unsaved edits included, with the properties panel stepping aside and the canvas taking its width while the sections rail stays.
  • Preview is read-only except the axle control (adding or deleting an axle writes the count back to the draft); no values, verdicts, Mark OK, Add Note or Add Photo are accepted, a reference file still opens, and the submit bar is not drawn.
  • Preview works on a draft without asking the author to publish first, and clicking a field returns to Edit with that field selected in the panel.
  • Preview explains nothing about itself: no banner saying nothing is saved, and no line stating how many axles the technician starts on.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R25: “The builder will offer a Preview mode alongside Edit, switched from a control in the sub-header. Preview mounts **the fill screen itself** against the current draft, unsaved edits included, so what the author sees cannot drift from what the technician gets. The properties panel steps aside and the canvas takes its width — the axle grid needs 800px and the panel is 360 — while the sections rail stays, so the author previews one section at a time”
  • S12-R31: “Preview is read-only, with one exception: the axle control. Adding or deleting an axle there writes the count back to the draft, so returning to Edit shows the new number on the Axles control (S12-R29) — Preview is where an author first sees the field at its real size and works out that three is not enough, and making them carry that number back by hand is the round trip the mode exists to remove. Nothing else accepts input: no values, no verdicts, no Mark OK, no Add Note, no Add Photo. A reference file still opens, because that is a read. The submit bar is not drawn at all — it belongs to an inspection rather than a template”
  • S12-R32: “Preview works on a draft and never asks the author to publish first. Clicking a field in Preview returns to Edit with that field selected in the panel, which is the round trip the mode exists to remove”
  • S12-R33: “Preview explains nothing about itself. It draws no banner saying that nothing is saved, and no line stating how many axles the technician starts on. The Edit and Preview control already says which mode the author is in, and the Axles control explains the count where it is set (S12-R29). A mode that narrates itself is exactly the subtext this document rules out”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
